$comment: What each app setting means to a user. The keys, defaults and options come from the Swift sources (scripts/generate.ts); every @AppStorage key in apps/ios/Sources needs an entry here, and every entry needs a key in code.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Light, Dark or System (follows the device).

accent.title: Accent Color
accent.description: The tint used for buttons, your message bubbles and highlights.

noticeHaptics.title: Haptic for In-App Notices
noticeHaptics.description: Plays a light haptic when a reply in another conversation shows as a notice at the top of the screen while Yorozu is open.

spotlightIndexing.title: Show Conversations in Siri and Search
spotlightIndexing.description: Lets Siri and Spotlight find conversations by their titles and recent messages. The index stays on the device and is removed when you unpair. Not shown in demo mode.

commandReturnSends.title: Send with ⌘Return
commandReturnSends.description: Off: Return sends a one-line message, Shift-Return adds a new line, and ⌘Return always sends. On: Return adds a new line and only ⌘Return sends.

voiceInput.title: Voice Input
voiceInput.description: Speak a message instead of typing it. Speech is transcribed on the device by the engine chosen under Model. With Apple Speech (the default on iOS 26 and macOS 26 and later) turning it on has the system download the language; with a downloaded model it downloads that model: from Apple as an asset pack on iPhone and iPad (iOS 26 or later), from Hugging Face on the Mac.

voiceInputEngine.title: Model
voiceInputEngine.description: The speech engine voice input uses, each listed with its download size, languages, the memory it needs, whether it streams, and its license: Apple Speech (built into iOS 26 and macOS 26; languages vary by device), LFM3-Audio-2B (about 1.44 GB, 18 languages, 6 GB of RAM), Whisper Large v3 Turbo (about 740 MB, 99 languages, 6 GB), Whisper Small (about 490 MB, 99 languages, 4 GB) and Nemotron 3.5 ASR (about 615 MB, 8 languages, 4 GB, streaming; Apple silicon on the Mac). A model whose iPhone and iPad asset pack isn't in App Store Connect yet shows Not available yet. Until you pick one, Apple Speech is used where it runs, and a device that already downloaded LFM3-Audio-2B keeps it. Delete removes a downloaded model that isn't selected. Licenses opens the license texts.

voiceInputLanguage.title: Language
voiceInputLanguage.description: The spoken language for voice input, each named in its own language: Automatic, or one of the languages the chosen model supports. Automatic detects the language with the downloaded models; with Apple Speech it uses the device's language, and the list shows only the languages Apple Speech supports on the device.

voiceDictionary.title: Dictionary
voiceDictionary.description: Names and words voice input gets wrong, up to 200, each with an optional Heard As. Every model is told to expect the words (Apple Speech's contextual strings, Whisper's prompt, Nemotron's custom vocabulary, LFM3-Audio's instruction), and wherever a transcript has a Heard As, the word replaces it, whole words only in spaced languages. The dictionary stays on the device and isn't in Copy Diagnostics.

YorozuZoomStep.title: Zoom
YorozuZoomStep.location: View › Zoom In (⌘+), Zoom Out (⌘−), Actual Size (⌘0)
YorozuZoomStep.description: Scales the app's text in seven steps from 75% to 200% (step -2 to 4, 0 is actual size), stored per device. Works on the Mac and on iPad with a keyboard; iPhone follows the system text size only.

YorozuBetaUpdates.title: Update to: Beta Versions
YorozuBetaUpdates.description: Off (Stable Versions): Sparkle offers only stable releases. On (Beta Versions): it also offers betas, which have the newest changes before a stable release.

widgetPreviews.title: Show Message Previews in Widgets
widgetPreviews.description: Off by default. Widgets and Lock Screen accessories show conversation titles, unread counts and reply times, hidden on the Lock Screen until the device is unlocked. On: the medium and large widgets also show the first line of the latest reply. The snapshot stays in the app's App Group container on the device and is deleted when you unpair.

turnLiveActivity.title: Show Live Activity
turnLiveActivity.description: On by default. One Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island follows the agent's turns, approvals waiting for you, and voice recording and transcription: up to three rows, each opening its conversation, with the tool step count and elapsed time. It shows conversation titles only while message previews are on, and never message text or tool details. It starts when you leave Yorozu with something running, ends when you return (unless a recording or transcription is running), keeps finished rows for about two minutes, and runs on the device only (no push).
